new_sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model DTM 1m official dataset record
facts: approximately 99 percent of England at 1m spatial resolution
composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys and uses newest best-resolution data where repeat surveys exist
download is 5km GeoTIFF aligned to OS National Grid, metres above Ordnance Survey Newlyn using OSTN15
individual source surveys entering the composite report plus/minus 15cm RMSE
official record exposes WCS plus survey-index and OGC Features routes and CRS EPSG:27700

new_sources.name: National LIDAR Programme official dataset record
facts: provides 1m elevation data for England
Phase 1 used 302 survey blocks captured between January 2017 and February 2023 and later repeat surveys receive incrementing phase numbers
products are published quarterly and supplied in 5km OS-grid tiles
tile filenames encode survey id, OS grid reference and first and last survey dates
DTM is ground-classified and manually filtered and catalogue records provide survey-specific information
CRS EPSG:27700

new_sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles official dataset record
facts: site-specific DTM archive spans surveys since 1998 at 25cm 50cm 1m and 2m resolutions
GeoTIFF rasters are delivered in 5km zipfiles aligned to the OS Grid
elevations are metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
transformation is specific to survey time and metadata index must provide date resolution transformation and geoidal model
CRS EPSG:27700 and product-level vertical accuracy plus/minus 15cm RMSE

new_sources.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys official dataset record
facts: independent ground-truth points have plus/minus 3cm RMSE and include survey date surface type survey method transformation and geoidal model
timestamped surveys are compared to ground truth using RMSE standard deviation and random error
survey QC requires less than plus/minus 15cm RMSE and 10cm standard deviation/random error
ground-truth quality metrics are survey-level validation and are not parcel-specific uncertainty without target validation
CRS EPSG:27700

new_sources.name: OS Terrain 50 Overview accuracy and maintenance
facts: OS Terrain 50 is an Open Data bare-earth DTM product
grid uses regular 50m post spacing and 10km-by-10km National Grid tiles
grid height points have been verified to 4m RMSE across geographic sample classes
product is maintained by an integrated 3-to-5-year flying programme
4m RMSE is a product-level accuracy metric and must not be promoted to parcel-specific confidence
